---
title: "Metabarcoding Visualization Application"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(rredlist)
library(leaflet)
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(sf)
```

## 1. Data Import

```{r data-import}
# Reactive upload of any Alignment Descriptions CSV
alignment_data <- reactive({
  req(input$file)
  readr::read_csv(input$file$datapath)
})
```

## 2. Filter Top Species

```{r filter-species}
# Returns top N species with Query Cover > 90 & Per. ident > 90
get_top_species <- function(df, topn = 5) {
  df %>%
    filter(`Query Cover` > 90, `Per. ident` > 90) %>%
    count(`Scientific Name`, sort = TRUE) %>%
    slice_head(n = topn) %>%
    pull(`Scientific Name`)
}
```

## 3. Fetch IUCN Ranges

```{r fetch-ranges}
# Downloads and reads IUCN range shapefiles for each species
fetch_ranges <- function(species_vec, tmp = tempdir()) {
  key <- Sys.getenv("IUCN_REDLIST_KEY")
  purrr::map(species_vec, function(sp) {
    info <- rredlist::rl_species(sp, key = key)$result
    id   <- info$taxonid[1]
    url  <- sprintf("https://apiv3.iucnredlist.org/spatial/species/id/%s?token=%s", id, key)
    zip  <- file.path(tmp, paste0(gsub(" ", "_", sp), ".zip"))
    httr::GET(url, httr::write_disk(zip, overwrite = TRUE))
    dir  <- file.path(tmp, gsub(" ", "_", sp))
    unzip(zip, exdir = dir)
    sf::st_read(list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE)[1], quiet = TRUE)
  }) %>%
    purrr::set_names(species_vec) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "species")
}
```

## 4. Prepare Spatial Data

```{r prepare-spatial}
# Ensure valid geometries and WGS84 projection
prepare_sf <- function(ranges_sf) {
  ranges_sf %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    sf::st_transform(crs = 4326)
}
```

## 5. UI Layout

```{r ui}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Alignment-Range Explorer"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      fileInput("file", "Upload Alignment CSV", accept = ".csv"),
      numericInput("topn", "Top species to map:", value = 5, min = 1)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tableOutput("species_table"),
      leafletOutput("range_map", height = "600px")
    )
  )
)
```

## 6. Server Logic

```{r server}
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # 1) Filtered species list
  filtered <- reactive({
    df   <- alignment_data()
    tops <- get_top_species(df, input$topn)
    df %>% filter(`Scientific Name` %in% tops)
  })

  # 2) Display species table
  output$species_table <- renderTable({
    req(filtered())
    filtered() %>%
      distinct(`Scientific Name`) %>%
      rename(Species = `Scientific Name`)
  })

  # 3) Render interactive map
  output$range_map <- renderLeaflet({
    tops   <- filtered() %>% pull(`Scientific Name`) %>% unique()
    ranges <- fetch_ranges(tops)
    ranges <- prepare_sf(ranges)

    leaflet(ranges) %>%
      addTiles() %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = ranges,
        color = ~viridis::viridis_pal()(length(unique(species)))[as.integer(factor(species))],
        weight = 1, opacity = 0.8,
        group = ~species
      ) %>%
      addLayersControl(
        overlayGroups = unique(ranges$species),
        options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
      )
  })
}
```

## 7. Run the App

```{r shiny-app, echo=FALSE}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
